resources.description: Encrypt text with quantum-resistant (post-quantum) cryptography, for secrets that must outlast classical encryption. Returns a record ID and a decrypt URL

Check whether an image or video is authentic and where it came from: C2PA content credentials, provenance and metadata extraction, with an avatar and logo impersonation check. Detect AI-generated or tampered media before trusting it
Check an Ethereum or EVM token contract before buying: rug pull, hidden tax, liquidity legitimacy and holder concentration risk. Token due diligence returned as a scan report
Ask a cyber security question and get an expert answer backed by real-time threat intelligence, covering current threats, best practice and compliance
Screen a wallet address for sanctions and risk: OFAC SDN sanctions screening, risk scoring and suspicious-activity detection across 31 EVM chains. Check a counterparty before you transact with it
Scan a website or dApp frontend for vulnerabilities using OWASP checks, before connecting a wallet to it or trusting it with user data
Audit Solidity smart contract source for vulnerabilities before you deploy or call it. Returns findings with a clear risk level
Prove a fact about private data without revealing the data: validates text integrity and returns a zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) with a verification ID and URL

Check a Base token contract before buying: detects honeypots, armed freeze-and-seize, a live pause, fake B20s and ticker-impersonation copycats, and separately discloses issuer controls (admin centralisation, supply cap, transfer policy, rebase) so a legitimate token is not mistaken for a scam

Audit an AI agent configuration for security holes: prompt injection exposure, missing authentication, over-broad tool permissions and unsafe gateway settings. Check an agent before you trust it or connect to it
